run_token_classification: run the TokenClassificationPipeline on a text string to extract named entities with scores
create_token_classification_pipeline: create a TokenClassificationPipeline instance by loading a pre-trained SpanMarker model from a model ID
review_token_classification_output: review the token classification output containing entity groups, words, start and end offsets, and confidence scores

summarize_token_classification_pipeline: summarize the TokenClassificationPipeline class that wraps SpanMarkerModel for named entity recognition on input text
